title: The Tunnel
draft: Built 2026-10-18 from the 4.6 stub with its defaults ('take the defaults and build 4.6'): three endings (ADR-52 as proposed) — Evacuate (Karthik, Rathore's convoy; if you didn't back Karthik at the fire he takes you and leaves the others; Deepa stays — 'they don't take the bitten'), Hold (Suresh; back to the glass house; he stays at the gate with the generator — unavoidable), Ground Zero (Priya; north under HIVR with the Pulse Gun; Ravi's state changes the last door; Deepa's reading of the log is on the screen) — every ending goes through the tunnel and splits at Majestic, chosen at Lalbagh's table; each ending is a card; then the 'My Bangalore' card (the run in numbers, SHARE through the OS sheet), then the title (no New Game+). Ananya is with you unless strained (the card's people line). The tunnel: the Purple Line from Cubbon Park west (a generated map: twin tracks, the walkway, a stalled train, emergency lights), two still packs in the cross-passages.
player_goal: Get your people through the tunnel to where you chose to go.
design_goal: The game's last route goes under the city the player watched being built in Acts 1–2 (the metro opened in 2.2). Dark, lit red, infected in the cross-passages. At Majestic the choice the group made at Lalbagh plays out. Each ending costs something; none is 'good'. Then the 'My Bangalore' card.

cast.role: The convoy, in the Evacuate card.
The gate, in the Hold card.
North with you, in the Ground Zero card.

beats.what: The last night: down at Cubbon Park station onto the tracks (a card); the Purple Line west in the dark, the stalled train, two still ones in the cross-passages — walk.
Majestic's platform: the table's choice plays — up to the trucks (Evacuate), north under HIVR (Ground Zero), or back to the glass house (Hold).
The ending card, then 'My Bangalore': days in the city, days it was shut, people you knew by name, ₹ on chai, City Moments, who came through with you — SHARE, or the title.

assets_needed: the Purple Line tunnel (generated, first try)
acceptance: all three endings reachable; each a card; the end card renders and shares
